paragraphs: Shimon ben Beteira. People of distinguished lineage and patriarchs who lived in Hillel the Elder's time, while the Temple stood. R' Akiva adds to his words in Eduyot 8:1 and Hagigah 23, end of side b. These three are mentioned there: R' Yehudah ben Beteira, R' Yehoshua ben Beteira, and this R' Shimon. Rashi, Ta'anit, first chapter, writes that R' Yehudah and R' Yehoshua are the sons of Beteira and that they gave the patriarchate to Hillel; see his entry. He forgot this R' Shimon. See what I wrote under R' Yehudah ben Beteira.
